AEI’s @natmalkus on declining test scores: We see everybody peaking in that 2012-2015 time frame. It’s not a cascade. It happened across the board.

Video
Congress must fix the annual federal budget dysfunction and bring its power of the purse into alignment with the defense of the nation, writes AEI’s Elaine McCusker. thehill.com/opinion/national…

AEI’s @TobiasPeterAEI: In the housing sector, we have not been building enough starter homes. We need to get back to that. Unfortunately, these bills that are currently floating around on the federal side, I’m afraid they’re not going to achieve that.

Video

AEI’s @continetti: Voters are always asking, “What have you done for us lately?” Unless the president can show real gains in the Strait of Hormuz, and on the price level and income growth, it is an uphill climb for Republicans in the fall.

Video

AEI’s Jenna Silber Storey joined leaders in higher education across the US to craft a vision for intellectual diversity on campus and defend the mission of higher education. radcliffe.harvard.edu/news-a…

If the economic optimists are correct, GenAI will be so broadly and usefully adopted that it eventually reshapes productivity across the entire American economy, writes AEI’s @JimPethokoukis aei.org/economics/an-expecte…

The fate of a record-breaking US weapons deal with Taipei has become a test of whether President Donald Trump can pursue strong, competitive policies even while he engages diplomatically with China, writes AEI's @HalBrands bloomberg.com/opinion/articl…

We need a culture that instills a sense of mutual obligation—a recognition that we are responsible for more than our own welfare, reputation, and brand, writes AEI's @dcoxpolls 
americanstorylines.com/p/wha…

For all the talk of the majority’s “right” to govern and the nationalization of American politics, most of us still believe in an important role for place-based representation, writes AEI’s @PhilipWallach theamericanenterprise.com/do…

Weakening the dollar, including by eroding policy predictability and the economic institutions underpinning its hegemony, will exacerbate the affordability pressures many Americans face and harm the country’s fiscal position, writes AEI's Glenn Hubbard. aei.org/op-eds/the-policy-pi…
When taking up other technologies in this document, the Pope is very concrete. But regarding AI, his approach evinces a genuine bewilderment, writes AEI’s Yuval Levin. thenewatlantis.com/publicati…
AEI’s Ruy Teixeira joins @WSJopinion’s All Things with @KimStrassel to discuss what’s next for the Democratic Party. wsj.com/podcasts/all-things-…

Out now: AEI’s Daniel Stid hosts Liz Joyner and Ash Hanson on The Art of Association to discuss “An Invitation to a New Civic Future,” a public letter that the three of them co-signed with nine other colleagues earlier this year.

Congress should stop trying to help families by adding new spending programs that inadvertently hurt the children they seek to help by burdening younger generations with higher taxes, writes AEI’s @kevincorinth washingtonexaminer.com/resto…

AEI’s @ConleyHeather1: This is not a ceasefire. It's a reduction in violence that can flare at any moment.

Video
